Introduction

TO1, originally known as TOO, was a boy group formed through the 2019 survival show World Klass. They debuted on April 1, 2020, under n.CH Entertainment with production by Stone Music Entertainment. Initially consisting of 10 members, they later became a nine-member group. In 2020, they competed on Road to Kingdom but were eliminated in the seventh episode.

Management disputes arose between CJ E&M (the parent company of Stone Music) and n.CH Entertainment, leading CJ E&M to take over fully and rebrand the group as TO1 in March 2021 under the WAKEONE label. They re-debuted with the EP Re:Born.

Over the course of 2022, several members (Chihoon, Minsu, Jerome, and Woonggi) departed, and new members (Renta, Daigo, and Yeojeong) joined. However, Renta also left the group later that year. Ultimately, WAKEONE announced on December 17, 2022, that all TO1 members decided not to renew their contracts, which officially ended on December 31, 2022.
